chapters.title: Twitter Space Hiccups and Welcome Back
chapters.description: Anthony explains the Twitter Space glitch where a Space appears live to the host but not to listeners until a minute or two passes. Ishan thanks the audience for rejoining and jokes about being a lesson for others before moving toward introductions.

chapters.title: Introducing JavaScript Jam Live and the Hosts
chapters.description: Ishan welcomes listeners to JavaScript Jam Live, an open mic for anything JavaScript and web development, and introduces the React Miami collaboration. Anthony introduces himself as a developer advocate at Edgio and announces guest Dev Agrawal, then invites Scott to speak.

chapters.title: Scott on React Miami Month and Audience Participation
chapters.description: Scott joins after the technical trouble and explains that the collaboration is really React Miami Month. He promises more React Miami speakers while keeping the traditional Jam vibe, and encourages beginners and experts alike to request the mic and share questions, opinions, or facts.

chapters.title: Guests Introduce Themselves as Media Partners
chapters.description: Anthony hands the floor to Dev, who introduces himself as a React Miami media partner and teases next week's plans. Dan jokes that a company offsite keeps him from attending, and Anthony then turns to Dev to describe his game show idea.

chapters.title: Miami Jam Game Show Announced and Michelle Joins
chapters.description: Dev reveals he has roped the hosts into a game show called Miami Jam. Michelle, an organizer of React Miami, joins after connection and microphone problems, says she is excited about the media partners, and notes they were given free rein to create content.

chapters.title: How Miami Jam Works: Trivia and Audience Interaction
chapters.description: Dev explains that Miami Jam replaces the standard interview or panel format with trivia about React, JavaScript quirks, TypeScript, and libraries. The questions lead into deeper talk about speakers' topics and motivations, while audience members can engage by asking questions and awarding points for answers.
